name: Beijing Shougang LanzaTech Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Beijing Shougang LanzaTech Technology Co., Ltd. works in the carbon capture, utilisation and storage industry. It mainly produces low-carbon products such as ethanol and microbial protein through carbon capture and utilisation technologies and provides low-carbon integrated solutions. Its ethanol is used as automotive fuel and as a raw material in perfumes, sportswear and cleaning agents.
